mapper.select: SELECT branch_num, branch_name, address FROM T_CinemaFranchise ORDER BY branch_num LIMIT 3

SELECT i.movie_title AS movieTitle, s.schedule_num AS scheduleNum, s.screening_date AS screeningDate, i.running_time AS runningTime, i.audience_rating AS audienceRating FROM T_Info i JOIN T_Schedule s ON i.movie_num = s.movie_num JOIN T_Theater t ON s.screening_num = t.screening_num JOIN T_CinemaFranchise c ON t.branch_num = c.branch_num WHERE REPLACE(c.branch_name,' ','') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{branchName}, ' ', ''), '%') AND s.screening_date >= NOW() -- ✅ 현재 시간 이후 상영만 AND DATE(s.screening_date) = CURDATE() -- ✅ 오늘만 ORDER BY s.screening_date ASC

SELECT st.seat_code AS seatCode, st.seat_real_num AS seat, st.seat_type AS seatType, st.sale AS price, -- ✅ sale 컬럼으로 수정 CASE WHEN r.seat_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS available FROM T_Seat st LEFT JOIN T_SeatReservation r -- ✅ ReservationInfo 말고 SeatReservation 사용 권장 ON st.seat_code = r.seat_code AND r.schedule_num = #{scheduleNum} AND r.reserved = TRUE -- ✅ 예약된 좌석만 제외 WHERE st.screening_num = (SELECT screening_num FROM T_Schedule WHERE schedule_num = #{scheduleNum}) ORDER BY st.seat_real_num ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_SeatReservation ( reservation_id, schedule_num, seat_code, reserved ) VALUES ( (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(reservation_id),9000) + 1 FROM T_SeatReservation), #{scheduleNum}, #{seatCode}, TRUE )
